# main

## Overview
Main source distribution directory: Java production sources and the resources packaged into the plugin.

## Subdirectories & Boundaries
- `java`: [./java/ABOUT.md](./java/ABOUT.md) - Hand-written plugin sources, including the `Dart.bnf` grammar and `.flex` lexer inputs for `../../gen/`.
- `resources`: [./resources/ABOUT.md](./resources/ABOUT.md) - `META-INF/plugin.xml` registrations, message bundles, icons, and other plugin resources.

## Invariants
- Distribution root.
